rule_description: order_status must be a recognized status value
order_approved_at must be on/after order_purchase_timestamp when present
order_delivered_carrier_date must be on/after order_purchase_timestamp when present
order_delivered_customer_date must be on/after order_purchase_timestamp when present
order_delivered_customer_date should not be null for orders with status = delivered
customer_state must be a valid Brazilian state code
freight_value must be greater than or equal to 0
(order_id, order_item_id) must be unique at item grain
payment_value must be greater than or equal to 0
payment_installments must be greater than or equal to 1
(order_id, payment_sequential) must be unique at payment grain
seller_state must be a valid Brazilian state code
product_weight_g must be greater than 0 when present
